🫏 New post ready 💬 One-liner · siblings · 🎬 Reel, 9.2s, wistful tune “four hundred miles apart, but you still send the screenshot of mum's text before i even open it.” ✍️ Caption
we haven't shared a hallway in six years, but my phone still buzzes the second she hits send. no extra words attached, because you already know what face i am making. send this to your sister if she always sends the screenshot first. #siblings #sisterlove #siblinglove #oldersiblings
